subject: math
topicName: Number of Sides and Angle Sums
description: Investigate patterns in polygon angle sums, use triangle decomposition, apply the formula (n - 2)180, and determine missing angle measures or number of sides.
learningObjectives: Explain why an n-sided polygon can be divided into n - 2 triangles from one vertex
Use the formula (n - 2)180 to find the sum of the interior angles of a polygon
Find one interior angle of a regular polygon using the angle sum divided by the number of sides
Determine the number of sides of a polygon from its interior angle sum
prerequisites: Identify polygons by number of sides
Know that the angles of a triangle add to 180 degrees
